    rw [Finset.prod_insert hi, Nat.totient_mul hcop, Nat.cast_mul,
      ih, Finset.prod_insert hi, Nat.totient_prime (hprime i)]

Prime>=2 proves actual1/(p-1) weight nonnegative. Fixed positive-exponent tuple mass limit follows by finite product of real actual one-prime limits, with no b<=1/parity restriction.

Adjacent separated boxes force strict decreasing primes even at equal exponent boundaries, by the strict upper cutoff. The reciprocal-totient identity separately requires actual injectivity; no such equality is asserted for overlapping boxes.
Private totient product induction proves coprimality of distinct primes and uses Nat.cast_sub only with prime>=2. Product is coprime to the target by each real prime exclusion.
Separated totient mass equality uses N>=1, and its limit pays that eventual gate. The zero-coordinate mass/limit is1. No distribution/count mean is supplied.

theorem finite_prod_ratio_of_split
    {α : Type*} (s t u : Finset α) (f g : α → ℝ)
    (ht : 0 < ∏ a ∈ t, f a)
    (hsplit : (∏ a ∈ t, f a) = (∏ a ∈ s, f a) * ∏ a ∈ u, f a)
    (hfg : ∀ a ∈ u, f a * g a = 1) :
    (∏ a ∈ s, f a) / (∏ a ∈ t, f a) = ∏ a ∈ u, g a := by
  have hcancel : (∏ a ∈ u, f a) * (∏ a ∈ u, g a) = 1 := by
    rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
    calc
      (∏ a ∈ u, f a * g a) = ∏ _a ∈ u, (1 : ℝ) := by
        apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
        exact hfg
      _ = 1 := by simp
  apply (div_eq_iff ht.ne').mpr
  rw [hsplit]
  calc
    (∏ a ∈ s, f a) = (∏ a ∈ s, f a) * 1 := by ring
    _ = (∏ a ∈ s, f a) * ((∏ a ∈ u, f a) * (∏ a ∈ u, g a)) := by
      rw [hcancel]
    _ = (∏ a ∈ u, g a) * ((∏ a ∈ s, f a) * (∏ a ∈ u, f a)) := by ring
